correctness.rationale: Left-normalization multiplies the regular convolution matrix by an invertible left translation and gives I+L_a-L_b. A matrix column y is delta_y+delta_(ay)-delta_(by), with three distinct supports; every row also has exactly three +/-1 entries. Swapping the two positive sites re-normalizes to (a^-1,a^-1 b); S_5-conjugation is a simultaneous A_5 automorphism and preserves rank. Each original kernel has exactly two ordered descriptions, so a normalized-pair count is multiplied by 60/2=30. Independently generated all 3422 normalized ordered pairs and 23 disjoint exhaustive orbits, and checked every pair's intrinsic rule and modular rank at both primes, not just representatives. Normalized counts for ranks 40,45,49,54,55,56,60 were 60,120,120,120,240,360,2402, exactly giving the stated 102660-kernel census. For (3,(5,5),60), 120 same-class pairs had rank 49 and 120 different-class pairs rank 60; the two five-cycle classes were computed and found inversion-stable. The CSV representatives, orbit sizes and order invariants agree. Both primes were checked by trial division. Each integer minor of size k<=60 has |det|<=3^(k/2)<=3^30 by Hadamard, less than the product of the primes. Thus agreement at d<60 forces all (d+1)-minors to vanish integrally while a nonzero d-minor mod a prime yields the lower bound; d=60 is maximal. All signed 64-bit elimination products and subtractions stay within range. The conclusion concerns complex rank and geometric nullity, not algebraic zero-eigenvalue multiplicity.
